title: Rainbow Chat
description: Chat Glow enhances your default Minecraft chat HUD by adding a subtle, dynamic glowing aura to all chat text.
body:
✨ Chat Glow (Rainbow Chat)

Chat Glow is a lightweight, client-side Fabric mod that upgrades the appearance and readability of your default Minecraft chat. It replaces the flat, static vanilla drop shadow with a beautiful, pulsing neon gold-to-orange glow outline.

📝 What It Does

Pulsing Glow Outline: Captures all text rendered in your chat HUD and wraps every character in a smooth, ambient glow that gently transitions between a warm neon gold and a vibrant orange.

Enhanced Readability: The 4-directional outline creates high contrast, making messages incredibly easy to read against bright backgrounds like snow, desert sand, or sky, where default chat text normally washes out.

Smooth Fading: Fully syncs with Minecraft’s default chat animations. As your chat messages fade away, the glow fades out naturally alongside them.

Highly Optimized: Built using efficient Sponge Mixins with zero frame drops, meaning you get premium visuals without sacrificing performance.

Client-Side Only: Runs entirely on your computer. You can safely join any vanilla or modded multiplayer server, and the glowing effect will work perfectly.


🛠️ How to Use It

Install Fabric: Ensure you have the Fabric Loader installed for Minecraft 1.21.1 (or compatible 1.21.x version)

Add the Mod: Download the modid-1.0.0.jar file and place it directly into your Minecraft mods folder (located inside your .minecraft directory).

Ensure Dependencies: Make sure you also have the Fabric API mod in your mods folder.

Play: Launch Minecraft using your Fabric profile, join any world or multiplayer server, and open your chat window—your messages will immediately start glowing!
